translation:
It grows [in/at] [blank]. It is gathered on the seventh day of the seventh month and dried in the shade [with] ganjiang (乾薑), danshen (丹參), huangqin (黃芩), shaoyao (芍藥), and muli (牡蠣) [blank].

Also, combine it with luanfa (亂髮, tangled hair) and shepi (蛇皮, snake skin), three ingredients together burned into ash, take one fangkunbi (方寸匕) with wine twice daily; it treats all malignant carbuncles (惡疽) and bone-adhered carbuncles (附骨癰) whose roots are in the viscera (臟腑), with joint-piercing swellings issuing out (歷節腫出).

The original text of the Benjing: Lufengfang (露蜂房), bitter in flavor, neutral.
